title: Sageview Capital Leads Strategic Financing Round for MetricStream
主要内容: MetricStream, a software company, raised $60 million in a strategic financing round led by Sageview Capital, with existing investors Goldman Sachs and Kaiser Permanente Ventures also contributing. The investment supports MetricStream's innovation and market leadership in the GRC (Governance, Risk, and Compliance) space, enabling expansion of its Pervasive GRC vision across industries and sizes. Ned Gilhuly, Co-Founder & Managing Partner of Sage, will join MetricStream's Board of Directors. The move reflects growing demand for GRC solutions as companies navigate complex regulatory and operational environments. MetricStream owns and operates www.ComplianceOnline.com, the largest GRC advisory network and one of the largest GRC communities, headquartered in Palo Alto, California, USA.
